originalTitle: Earthquake rocks Spain's historic Granada, injuring three
summary: A number of buildings and cars are damaged in the historic city, and the world famous Alhambra palace has temporarily closed.
content:
Watch: Terrified pets and crushed cars as earthquake shakes Granada

At least three people have been lightly injured and a number of buildings damaged after an earthquake rocked southern Spain.

The epicentre of the magnitude 4.8 tremor on Tuesday morning was about 10km (six miles) south of the historic city of Granada, the country's National Geographic Institute (IGN) said.

Many local residents were seen rushing out of their homes into the streets, fearing strong aftershocks. A number of vehicles were damaged by falling debris. Some museums, administrative buildings and sports centres have been forced to close.

The IGN said it was the latest in a series of very shallow tremors in the area that started last Friday and were widely felt.

A number of vehicles were damaged by falling debris in Tuesday's earthquake

The tremor struck at 10:37 local time (08:37 GMT) near the town of Alhendín, the IGN said. It was recorded at the depth of under 10km.

Alfonso Malpica said he felt his ground floor flat in Granada shaking, telling El País newspaper that the quake was "stronger than the ones that happen from time to time, the ones we're used to".

"Everything came crashing down. It was terrifying," Cristina Ruiz Lopez, a lab worker who was at a supermarket in Granada, was quoted as saying by the AFP news agency.

Granada's famous Alhambra palace - a Unesco World Heritage Site of medieval Islamic architecture - "will remain closed this afternoon", the site administrators said.

The palace is visited every year by millions of tourists from around the world.

Meanwhile, Granada's metro network said it was reducing the speed of its trains to 30km/h (19mph) for "safety reasons" and warned that this may cause delays.
chineseTitle: 西班牙历史悠久的格拉纳达发生地震，造成三人受伤
chineseSummary: 这座历史名城的多座建筑物和汽车遭到损坏，世界著名的阿罕布拉宫也已暂时关闭。
chineseContent:
观看：格拉纳达地震中受惊的宠物和被压碎的汽车

西班牙南部发生地震，造成至少三人受轻伤，多座建筑物受损。

该国国家地理研究所 (IGN) 表示，周二上午发生的 4.8 级地震震中位于历史名城格拉纳达以南约 10 公里（6 英里）处。

许多当地居民因担心强烈余震而从家中冲出街道。一些车辆被掉落的碎片损坏。一些博物馆、行政大楼和体育中心被迫关闭。

IGN 表示，这是该地区上周五开始的一系列极浅地震中的最新一起，人们普遍有感。

周二的地震中，许多车辆被掉落的碎片损坏

IGN 称，当地时间 10 点 37 分（格林尼治标准时间 08 点 37 分）阿尔亨丁镇附近发生了地震。它是在不到10公里的深度记录的。

阿方索·马尔皮卡说，他感到格拉纳达的一楼在摇晃，他告诉《国家报》，这次地震“比我们所习惯的时不时发生的地震还要强烈”。

法新社援引格拉纳达一家超市的实验室工作人员克里斯蒂娜·鲁伊斯·洛佩兹的话说：“一切都崩溃了。这太可怕了。”

格拉纳达著名的阿罕布拉宫 - 联合国教科文组织世界遗产中世纪伊斯兰建筑 - “今天下午将保持关闭”，网站管理员说。

每年都有数百万来自世界各地的游客参观这座宫殿。

与此同时，格拉纳达的地铁网络表示，出于“安全原因”，其将列车速度降低至 30 公里/小时（19 英里/小时），并警告称，这可能会导致延误。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
